articles.title: Rubio says Tehran missed 'multiple' chances for nuclear deal amid Iran stalemate
articles.description: Iran has failed to take advantage of "multiple opportunities" to reach a deal on its nuclear program, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Wednesday.

articles.title: Google ordered to halt work on two data centers in ‘Texas of Europe’
articles.description: Finland has emerged as a key location for data centers amid the AI boom.

articles.title: Jaguar unveils $130,000 electric vehicle two years after controversial rebrand
articles.description: The launch comes as luxury rivals Ferrari and Bentley also push into EVs, seeking to test wealthy buyer's appetite for going electric.

articles.title: Chevron CEO warns against 'unwise' diesel export ban, saying it could make things worse
articles.description: His comments come as rising Middle East crude exports and an emergency G7 stockpile release appear to have helped to ease supply fears.

articles.title: Rain is seeking a national trust bank charter to bypass third-party banks
articles.description: The stablecoin payments company’s proposed New York trust bank would custody digital assets and dollars, manage stablecoin reserves and issue and redeem dollar-backed tokens.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs rebound with $119M inflow as Ether extends losses
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs returned to net inflows with $119 million on Tuesday despite falling prices, while Ether funds reached a six-session outflow streak totaling $408 million.

articles.title: Ledger Launches Bitcoin Loans, Letting Holders Borrow Without Selling
articles.description: Unveiled at TOKEN2049 Singapore, the Morpho-powered Crypto Loan feature lets users borrow stablecoins against wrapped Bitcoin while keeping private keys and final approval on their hardware device.

articles.title: Robinhood adds bitcoin worth $25 million to its balance sheet

articles.title: BitMine sets 5% Ether supply ‘hard cap’ as accumulation target nears

articles.title: Treasury yields rise ahead of closely-watched 10-year auction and FOMC minutes
articles.description: U.S. Treasury yields climbed early Wednesday after retreating in the previous session, as investors awaited a closely watched 10-year note auction.

articles.title: Russia clears first crypto exchanges, custodians under new law

articles.title: Down but not out. Bitcoin's stair-step bullish trajectory is still intact
